title: A dumb belch of hunger cleft his speech
html_source:
Desperately difficult to remain objective about this gorgeous blurt. We’ve got a nice bit of external narrative and condemnation by vowel sound:

A dUMb bELch of hUNger clEft his speech.

Amidst the matrix of this episode (Aeolus, wind language, rhetoric, journalistic styling, nationalism, male dubs blathering on about shite, their innane social intercourse excluding Leopold) Joyce confirms with staggering efficiency the schism between Leopold’s frail ownership of Irishness and the intelligentsia’s borrowed enjoyment of rebellious histrionics.
